note: Family-owned seasonal RV park among pines 3 miles east of Babbitt, near Birch Lake; none of the sites are on the lake. The public beach, fishing pier and picnic area are reached by a path, and the public boat landing is half a mile east. Campers must be self-contained. --Claude
summary: Operator site read: 'The park is a seasonal RV park only'; the rates page posts only a season (May 1 - Oct 1), an annually set seasonal rate with metered electric and a waiting list, no cards. No nightly rate or booking anywhere. Full hookups 20/30/50 amp; no showers, restrooms or dump station (stored dump true was wrong). ATVs ride from sites to the trails. Drop candidate on the seasonal/residential rule.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (seasonal-only, five tests; operator's own wording): home page 'The park is a seasonal RV park only'; title 'Birch Lake RV Park and Campground | Seasonal'; rates page 'Season: May 1st - October 1st. The seasonal rate is set each year, and metered electricity is paid separately by each site. Please email us if you would like to be added to our waiting list for the future. No credit/debit cards.' No nightly rate, no booking engine, no price published at all. Fails test 4 (no nights sold) and the presence/price requirement. The stored note's 'books nightly via RoverPass/Hipcamp' is contradicted by the operator; no RoverPass or Hipcamp link appears on its site.

ATV wording (operator's own): 'nearby are the Stony Spur and Jackpot Trails for ATVers to enjoy. ATVs are allowed in the campground, but can only be driven on the road from the campsite to the trail.' Secondary to the seasonal drop.
Fees: none stored and none published (seasonal rate 'set each year', not stated). The price gate cannot be applied.
Facilities corrected: dump true -> false ('The park does not have a Dump Station'); vault_toilets false was not stated by the operator (left as stored).

Booking: stored reservable true / platform roverpass is unsupported; the operator offers only a seasonal waiting list by email. Not rewritten (the entry is a drop candidate); reviewer to clear booking if kept.
Google Maps: 'Birch Lake RV Park', 4.7 from 28 reviews, 2015 Hwy 623, Babbitt, no phone listed; Google's pin 47.71454,-91.89629 is about 107 m from the stored pin. No move needed.
Phone: none stored, none on the operator's site (email only, IllsleyAdventures@gmail.com, a business address). Website https://www.birchlakervpark.com/ answers 200 and is this park.

Note cleaned: dropped the hookups, 'big-rig/pull-through friendly' (the operator says 'spacious sites to accommodate large RVs', nothing about pull-throughs), the dump station (wrong) and 'books nightly via RoverPass/Hipcamp' (contradicted).
